# Professional policy update

Document notice-professional. Version 2. Effective from 2026-09-01. Audience: customers. Banana Bank is a simulated bank: this document describes only the policies of the test environment, in euros. Balances and movements come from the customer's bank ledger, never from this document.

## What changes

Professional moves to a base fee of EUR 9 per month from September 1, 2026 (previously EUR 11). No salary waiver is introduced for this product.

## What does not change

This update replaces the amounts in historical copies; it does not affect balances or fees already posted to the ledger. Limits and transfer rules are unchanged: see Professional · fees and conditions (professional-fees-2026).
